versions.changelog: Initial release - 10 Conditional Access policies, rollout order, risk analysis, break-glass guidance.

dependencies.description: CA004 (Require Compliant or Hybrid Joined Device for Admins) uses the 'compliantDevice' grant control, which has no signal to evaluate without the compliance policies defined in intune-compliance-starter. If CA004 is in report-only mode for 14+ days and intune-compliance-starter has not been purchased, show the upsell trigger defined in that product's source/gtm-content.md.
CA003 (Require MFA for All Users) ships in report-only mode. mfa-rollout-kit's Phase 3 (enf002) is the recommended path to safely switch CA003 to enforced after a 3-week registration rollout.
